title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDⓈ-M STPT and WAXP Perpetual Contracts With Up to 50x Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will launch the USDⓈ-M STPT and WAXP Perpetual Contracts at  2023-10-18 14:30 (UTC) and 2023-10-18 14:45 (UTC)  respectively,   with up to 50x leverage.  More details on the USDⓈ-M STPT and WAXP Perpetual Contracts can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract STPTUSDT WAXPUSDT Launch Time  2023-10-18 14:30 (UTC)  2023-10-18 14:45 (UTC)  Underlying Asset STPT WAXP Settlement Asset USDT USDT Tick Size 0.00001 0.00001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 50x 50x Trading Hours 24/7 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Supported Please Note:  The maximum funding rate of the STPTUSDT and WAXPUSDT Perpetual Contracts at the time of launch are +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2023-10-18 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2023-10-18 20:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2023-10-19 00:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2023-10-19 04:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the STPTUSDT and WAXPUSDT Perpetual Contracts from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the STPTUSDT and WAXPUSDT Perpetual Contracts across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the STPTUSDT and WAXPUSDT Perpetual Contracts.  The STPTUSDT and WAXPUSDT Perpetual Contracts are subject to the terms of the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
